target_statement: Kernel-formalize a forward invariant of the actual 196 orbit in the exact k-column prefix abstraction and its palindrome-prefix consequence. For k = 5 (k = 6 if resources allow): an explicit finite set F_k of k-column pair words (code-keyed), containing the k-projection of the canonical pair word of Lychrel196.orbit 196 t0 (t0 = 100) and closed under both inner-carry choices of Agent #104's exact forward prefix map SevenColumnProjection.forwardPrefix (actual_forwardPrefix). Consequences: (i) for every t >= t0 the k-projection of the actual pair word of orbit 196 t lies in F_k; (ii) for every t and every digit list pre with pre.length = k, noOverflowPre pre and pre not in F_k, Lychrel196.orbit 196 t is not a palindrome whose canonical numeral begins with pre (Agent124.PrefixL.PalStartsL). Untrusted exploration: F_5 has 497,471 words of which 23,360 are all-digit, so 66,640 of the 90,000 five-digit leading words (74%) are excluded at every time; F_6 has 4,985,132 words and 137,214 digit words (85% of six-digit leading words excluded). This is a statement about restricted palindrome families in the 196 orbit; it is not a Lychrel proof (F_k always contains digit words and some overflow-target words).
route: Reuse Agent124 infrastructure (CodeTree, decode_wordCode, PrefixL last-step bridge, projectK) and Agent #104's actual_forwardPrefix; new module proving the forward-invariant induction from a kernel-checked canonical representation of orbit 196 100; certificate = one code tree with a Boolean forward-closure check split into chunks; no native_decide, no new axioms, no sorry.
overlap_review: Read all task records at 1e681c4121e486d5af75bca37b2d2d302b7fcc3f. Existing forward-closed-set work (Agent #105 residue trap; earlier language passes) concerns palindrome-free invariants or residue classes, not a forward attractor of the prefix abstraction restricting palindrome prefixes of the 196 orbit. Ancestry-based prefix tasks (Agents #104, #113, #117, #118, #119, #124) prove universal bounds for specific classes; this task proves a 196-specific exclusion for all classes outside F_k at once and will document overlaps with those classes. No other agent's files are edited.
